MS ERW Round Pipe Overview
MS ERW (Electric Resistance Welded) round pipes are the most widely used steel pipe product in India, serving applications from plumbing and scaffolding to structural fabrication and industrial piping. Manufactured by forming hot rolled steel strips into circular cross-section and welding the longitudinal seam through electric resistance heating, ERW pipes offer consistent quality, dimensional accuracy, and cost-effectiveness.
India produces over 10 million TPA of ERW pipes across hundreds of manufacturers, from large players like APL Apollo Tubes, Tata Steel, and Jindal (India) to regional mills. The product is standardized under IS 1239 (for sizes up to 150 NB) and IS 3589 (for larger diameters), ensuring reliability across all applications.
MS ERW round pipe pricing tracks HR coil rates (the primary raw material) with a conversion premium covering forming, welding, testing, and finishing. OfBusiness provides contractors, fabricators, and industrial buyers with competitive pipe pricing from verified manufacturers, complete with test certificates and flexible delivery to construction sites and factories across India.
Sizes, Classes & Standards
MS ERW round pipes are produced in a comprehensive range of sizes and wall thicknesses:
As per IS 1239 Part 1 (up to 150 NB):
Light Class:
 Thinnest wall, suitable for low-pressure applications, cable conduits, and light structural use.
Medium Class:
 Standard specification for plumbing, general engineering, and moderate-pressure applications. Most commonly used class.
Heavy Class:
 Thickest wall for higher pressure ratings, industrial steam lines, and fire-fighting systems.
As per IS 3589 (above 150 NB):
 For water and sewerage transmission. Sizes from 200 NB to 600 NB with wall thickness 4.0-12.0 mm.
Scaffolding pipes:
 48.3 mm OD x 3.2 mm (medium class, IS 1161) - standard for construction scaffolding throughout India.
Grades:
 Fe 330 (IS 1239), E250/E350 (IS 3589), YSt 210/YSt 240 (IS 1161). Galvanized variants (GI pipes) available with zinc coating of 300-610 g/m2 as per IS 4736.
Testing:
 Hydraulic test at specified pressure, flattening test, bend test, weld integrity check (eddy current/UT). All pipes supplied with manufacturer's test certificate.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the current MS ERW round pipe price in India?
MS ERW round pipe prices depend on size (NB 15mm to 150mm), thickness (light/medium/heavy), and brand. Prices are quoted per kg or per piece (6m length). They track HR coil prices with a conversion premium. Check OfBusiness for today's competitive pricing from APL Apollo, Tata, Jindal, and other leading manufacturers.
What IS standards apply to MS ERW round pipes?
IS 1239 Part 1 covers mild steel tubes for general engineering (light, medium, heavy classes). IS 3589 covers pipes for water and sewerage (above 150 NB). IS 1161 covers steel tubes for general engineering purposes. IS 3601 covers steel tubes for mechanical and general engineering. Scaffolding pipes typically conform to IS 1161.
What sizes are available in MS ERW round pipes?
MS ERW round pipes are available from 15 NB (21.3 mm OD) to 150 NB (168.3 mm OD) as per IS 1239. Larger sizes up to 610 mm OD are available under IS 3589. Common sizes include 15 NB, 20 NB, 25 NB, 32 NB, 40 NB, 50 NB, 65 NB, 80 NB, and 100 NB. Standard length is 6 meters.
What is the difference between light, medium, and heavy class pipes?
These classes (as per IS 1239) differ in wall thickness: Light class has the thinnest wall (lowest pressure rating, lowest weight), Medium class is the standard specification, and Heavy class has the thickest wall (highest pressure rating, heaviest). Medium class is most commonly specified for plumbing and general use. Heavy class is used for higher-pressure applications.
Who are the leading MS ERW round pipe manufacturers?
APL Apollo Tubes is India's largest, followed by Tata Steel (Tata Pipes), Jindal (India), Surya Roshni, Hi-Tech Pipes, Welspun Corp (large diameter), and Maharashtra Seamless (for seamless). For standard ERW pipes (up to 150 NB), APL Apollo, Tata, and Surya Roshni are the dominant brands.
Can MS ERW pipes be used for water supply?
Yes, MS ERW pipes are used for water supply when internally and externally coated (cement mortar lining + bituminous/polyethylene coating). For potable water, they must be galvanized (GI pipes) or lined. For raw water transmission, IS 3589 pipes with appropriate coating are specified. DI pipes are increasingly preferred for pressurized water supply due to longer life.
